scores.evidence: Schema still requires only component, maturity and contract (packages/ui-foundation/contracts/schema/component-intent.schema.json:8-13, lists :72); states and slots stay optional: alert, app-view and separator have no states list, portal-container and sidebar-nav-tree no slots list (node sweep of contracts/components, 80 files). New since r2: check:contract-consistency now runs checkSlots (scripts/design-system/lib/contract-consistency.mjs:23-25,150-166; wired at scripts/design-system/check-contract-consistency.mjs:20,65; CI .github/workflows/ci.yml:155), so contract slots are now tied to rendered data-slot values, but 23 misses are baselined (docs/design-system/audits/contract-consistency-baseline.json:2-24: 14 calendar, 8 menu, 1 autocomplete). Axes and states are still not tied to React props or recipes: a sweep of component .tsx finds hand-typed axis props with no contract list (toggle-group size/tone toggle-group.tsx:30-31, connected-panel variant connected-panel.tsx:89, context-menu item variant context-menu.tsx:136), and a recipe sweep finds :hover/:focus-visible drawn but not listed in ~28 contracts (e.g. checkbox, menubar, navigation-menu, sidebar, button-group, field, table). APG bindings: 9 of 80 contracts carry contract.accessibility.

`node scripts/design-system/check-contract-consistency.mjs` -> 'Contract consistency OK (80 contracts).' with the same 5 baselined synonyms (contract-consistency-baseline.json:25-29). The value lint itself is unchanged since r2 (git diff 099d1eba..HEAD of lib/contract-consistency.mjs adds only checkSlots), so list-name synonyms (drawer.json:6 'directions' vs sheet 'sides'; connected-panel.json:7 'aligns' vs tooltip.json:7 'alignments'), *Sizes lists (sidebar.json:11 'default'), tone names (menu.json:6 'primary'), neutral status ('default' in alert.json:7 vs 'neutral' stateTones), failure states ('failed' vs 'error') and slot conventions (calendar/menu class-name suffixes) are still unlinted.

findings.subject: all-contracts
findings.summary: New: the slot check baselines 15 contract slots that are never rendered as data-slot outside menu: 14 of calendar's 15 slots are a63-Calendar-* class names, and autocomplete-surface is a class. `atom63 component calendar` serves them as Slots, so an agent targeting [data-slot="calendar-day"] matches nothing (the defect class of r2-contracts-1, on a less central component).
findings.evidence: docs/design-system/audits/contract-consistency-baseline.json:2-16; packages/ui-react/src/components/calendar/calendar.tsx:93-105 (classNames only; data-slot only at :153); packages/ui-react/src/components/autocomplete/autocomplete.tsx:178; `pnpm -s atom63 component calendar` line 39.
findings.fix: Render data-slot on each DayPicker part via its components/props (or list only the real data-slots), render data-slot="autocomplete-surface", and drop the baseline entries.

findings.subject: all-contracts
findings.summary: New: ContextMenuItem takes a hand-typed variant 'default' | 'destructive' that the context-menu contract does not list, while dropdown-menu declares the same axis as itemVariants.
findings.fix: Add itemVariants (or a shared menu list) to context-menu and menubar contracts and type the prop from the generated contract.
